source_corrections.old_source: PROVISIONAL author seed (fruit/vegetable; research/02 group 1 examples list fruit)
source_corrections.new_source: PROVISIONAL (nalt-names-8 citation correction): Martinez Steele et al., J Nutr2023 Table1 Group1, "Natural, packaged, cut, chilled or frozen vegetables, fruits, potatoes, cassava, and other roots and tubers"; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10127522/ . Tomato is not literally named in that example clause: class-instance of a plain vegetable/plant fruit. Current USDA NALT Product50832 explicitly identifies the tomatoes food product under vegetables and its cherry/grape/plum tomato food types, https://lod.nal.usda.gov/nalt/en/page/50832 ; checked2026-11-22, CC BY4.0, identity/category only, not NOVA. Plain food or source-named minimal process, no added substances; unsupported powders, extracts and preserved/added-substance forms are not placed by this citation. Existing form guards unchanged. Current Table1 Group3 independently supports same-food preparations with culinary additions: "These are relatively simple products manufactured essentially with the addition of salt or sugar or other substances of common culinary use, such as oil or vinegar, to unprocessed or minimally processed foods." Item-own salt/sugar/brine or explicit culinary additions use the existing Group3 guard; unknown additions and preserved/canned forms without sufficient composition still abstain.
source_corrections.rationale: New cultivar aliases require current source-backed vegetable placement, not only the legacy author seed.

notes: Whole Portobello phrase protects against the existing short alias repeating the mushroom noun.
Green onions already resolve to onion; not counted as a new food. Fresh green beans already resolve to beans, but broad dry/fresh aliases remain held.
Existing mung/black-gram wording maps to dal. New compact/spelling variants stay held rather than expand an unreviewed whole-vs-split food mapping.
Two constructed non-NALT whole spelling variants are held. Only the current-page explicit Portobello Mushrooms phrase is added, with the existing reviewed Portobello to Portabella route.
Summer Squash already answersGroup1 on baseline, so no new alias is added and it is not treated as an abstention hold.

Unqualified Sugared prefixes still abstain. Explicit food-powder Sugar brackets takeGroup3 through current same-food plus culinary-ingredient guards, except conservative red-mombin colour parsing. Red-mombin whole/pure powder forms remain a disclosed abstention gap.
